title: Checkout times out under load
description: Checkout API returns 504 when more than 200 concurrent users hit it. Seen during the Black Friday load test.

comments.author: Dana Kim
comments.body: Profiling shows N+1 queries on the cart items lookup. Root cause: lazy loading in OrderRepository.

comments.author: Dana Kim
comments.body: Fixed by batching the lookup with a single IN query. I considered adding a Redis cache but we rejected it because cache invalidation on price changes is risky.

comments.author: Raj Patel
comments.body: Gotcha: the batch query must stay under 1000 ids, Postgres plan flips to seq scan above that.
